description: Bounded transport/admission contract between XaaS RemoteRelay and a remote gall-work worker. Transport never creates DO authority; consequential execution remains in the existing XaaS lease/actuation path.

envelope.sequence: positive integer; next fresh command is last_acknowledged_sequence + 1
envelope.expiry: expires_at, when present, is an epoch-millisecond deadline
envelope.manifest: execution_manifest_digest must equal the worker session manifest
envelope.actuation_authority: verb=actuate requires channel=control and a non-empty authority_ref

gall_work_binding.local_do_ack: worker must independently require explicit local allow-do; authority_ref is necessary but not sufficient

replay.disconnect_before_ack: same command_id and semantic identity are retried; no fresh identity is manufactured
replay.after_ack: duplicate command_id or acknowledged sequence returns KNOWN_REPLAY
replay.consequence_bound: a durably receipted duplicate must not spawn zcode again

evidence_ceiling: Contract and repository-local replay/admission semantics only. This does not prove deployment, host reachability, production authority, customer authority, or external standing.
